''See also: [[Samara's ring Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Samara]]'s [[ring]] is a massive, pale [[white halo]] of light that circles the summit of [[Mount Samara]], the tallest of the four [[holy peaks]] located in [[Sacred Valley]]. This celestial feature is actually an ancient [[construct]] made of [[light aura]], created by an expert many centuries ago. The [[ring]] appears at sunset and vanishes at sunrise, ensuring that the [[inhabitants]] of [[Sacred Valley]] never experience a dark night. Because it provides constant illumination, it has influenced local culture, specifically encouraging the practice of light-aspect arts among [[sacred artists]]. The [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]] utilizes the [[ring]] to collect [[light aura]], even during moonless nights. The [[ring]]'s presence has significant environmental and practical effects. While it illuminates the valley with a light that can appear thicker than an arm or resemble a river of light, its quality varies; in some areas, it casts harsh shadows, while in others, it provides a thin, dreamy glow that makes surroundings look as though they are dipped in milk. The [[ring]] also acts as an attractant for [[Remnants]], particularly those with light [[aspects]], which can make the territory around the mountain unpredictable and dangerous at night. The [[ring]]'s stability is tied to the mountain's underlying power; it can be damaged by powerful entities like a [[Dreadgod]], and its color or consistency can change if the power sources beneath the valley shift.}}
